v4_share_gate.scope: One-way gate on held-out one-learner/three-v4 win share, strictly >95%; changes ordinary tables only. PFSP histories and rating lineups unchanged.

entropy_control.scope: Final raw policy on fixed IL probe; prospective post-warmup baseline, no retired IL action checks

quality_pool.scope: Unweighted learner/snapshot pairs in completed history tables only; p/IL share used are frozen before collection. Decayed rates are training diagnostics, not PL strength.

measurement.scope: Fixed IL validation positions; raw temperature-1 policies, no exploration; symmetric floor/renormalization for KL

utilization.actor_cpu_scope: Python actor process CPU during games; includes its threads, excludes Mono children and GPU; unavailable for cached games/multiple host lanes
utilization.scope: ordinary collection; actor/inference phase times overlap; actor_python_* measures process CPU, not total machine or GPU utilization

replay_ingress.scope: Reader-task CPU excludes process startup and result serialization; worker elapsed phases overlap across readers. Wall is the final join/merge; average cores uses the full streaming interval when enabled.

critic_training.scope: Retained PPO steps with nonempty critic batches and positive value_weight; calibration and PPG excluded

gae_stage_evidence.scope: Current lambda stage, committed rolling window; retained PPO critic work from healthy iterations only; zero steps alone do not reset health

historical.extension_age_scope: Committed collections using this lambda stage; qualification at lambda=1 does not count
historical.review: Inspect common PL rating slope/uncertainty and by-table advantage std; no automatic rollback

evidence.scope: Pooled row-weighted online EV at retained post-PPO weights; same contributing iterations for self-play; distinct whole-game support, learner seats only; not current-model re-evaluation or independent confidence bounds

historical.streak_scope: Consecutive PPO/economic health and applicable value KL guard; critic work supported across the mixed-table EV window

legacy.extension_age_scope: Committed collections using this lambda stage; qualification at lambda=1 does not count
